review_locator: PMID:11748254, The central role of SOCS-3 in integrating the neuro-immunoendocrine interface; PMCID:PMC6529849, The interleukin-6 family of cytokines
primary_title: Autoregulation of pituitary corticotroph SOCS-3 expression: characterization of the murine SOCS-3 promoter
decision_basis: The reviews describe LIF-driven STAT-dependent SOCS3 autoregulation; the cited primary shows LIF-induced endogenous SOCS3 mRNA and promoter activity requiring the STAT1/STAT3 response element.
limitations_preserved: Gene-level negative-feedback bridge; preserve the corticotroph STAT1/STAT3 promoter-element context and do not infer CNS glial weighting.

review_locator: PMID:11748254, The central role of SOCS-3 in integrating the neuro-immunoendocrine interface; PMCID:PMC409825, JCI LIF/SHP1/SOCS3 signaling study
primary_title: Inhibitory roles for SHP-1 and SOCS-3 following pituitary proopiomelanocortin induction by leukemia inhibitory factor
decision_basis: The reviews describe LIF-induced corticotroph POMC transcription; the cited primary shows LIF-induced POMC promoter activity and bounded SHP1/SOCS3 regulation of the response.
limitations_preserved: Corticotroph gene-output bridge; preserve the promoter-assay and negative-regulation context and do not generalize to other LIF-responsive tissues.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response; PMCID:PMC2724982, Interleukin-10: new perspectives on an old cytokine
primary_title: Involvement of suppressor of cytokine signaling-3 as a mediator of the inhibitory effects of IL-10 on LPS-induced macrophage activation
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-1 receptor antagonist as an IL-10-enhanced anti-inflammatory macrophage output; the cited primary reports enhanced IL-1 receptor antagonist mRNA in IL-10-treated, LPS-stimulated macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Gene-output bridge is LPS-co-stimulation dependent; preserve the IL-10/STAT3/SOCS3 context and do not infer free IL-1RA protein abundance without a separate protein assay.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8750894, GILZ as a Regulator of Cell Fate and Inflammation; PMCID:PMC7037253, Biology and therapeutic potential of interleukin-10
primary_title: Synthesis of glucocorticoid-induced leucine zipper (GILZ) by macrophages: an anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive mechanism shared by glucocorticoids and IL-10
decision_basis: The reviews identify GILZ as an IL-10-induced macrophage anti-inflammatory effector; the cited primary shows IL-10 stimulates GILZ production in human and mouse macrophages in vitro and in vivo.
limitations_preserved: Intracellular protein-expression output, not secreted ligand release; preserve macrophage and IL-10 context and do not treat GILZ as a terminal TF.
